description: Crosswalk from the medical MVP data dictionary to the SBC InsurancePlan profile of the CARIN Digital Insurance Card implementation guide. One entry per item of shall-should.json, in the same order, with the element, the verdict and the note for each program the item applies to. scripts/build-rtb-crosswalk.js reads this file with shall-should.json, fhir/carin-sbc-crosswalk.json and the Benefit Plan Standard converter specification and writes carin-crosswalk.md in this folder.
attribution: The assignments follow the workgroup's medical MVP scope (Monica Chopra's pledge proposal, October 2026).

verdicts.aligned: The value lands in a profile element with the same meaning and no loss; converter specification section 6 maps it directly.
verdicts.different: The value reaches the Bundle, but in a Benefit Plan Standard extension, as text only, or with a loss that converter specification section 7 names. The note says which.
verdicts.not_covered: The Bundle does not carry the item. The note says why.

reasons.no_element: the SBC InsurancePlan profile has no element for the item and the Benefit Plan Standard converter emits nothing
reasons.gap: the item is an open gap, so there is nothing to map yet

gap_note: A gap is work on the 2 importers, listed in the README, and the note says what travels today. No gap is open: the 8 known in earlier versions, G1 to G8, were closed on October 20, 2026.

ballot.status: in the STU2 ballot, September 2026; ballot-stage element

FHIR-57525.sentence: The qualifier is bound to the Cost Tier value set (FHIR-57525, multi-tier cost sharing)

FHIR-57526.title: deductible applicability
FHIR-57526.sentence: Whether a step counts toward the deductible travels in the DeductibleApplies extension on each `cost` entry (FHIR-57526, deductible applicability)

FHIR-57527.title: structured benefit limitation
FHIR-57527.sentence: The SBC InsurancePlan profile's element for limits is the BenefitLimitation extension on `coverage.benefit` (FHIR-57527, structured benefit limitation)

quoted.note: Quoted verbatim in `source_references`, which the Benefit Plan Standard converter writes as text in `bps-source-reference`.

placed.note: The benefit is placed in `coverage.benefit` and `plan.specificCost.benefit`. Each step is a `cost` entry with `applicability` in-network, `type` coded copay or copaypct and `value` the amount or rate; basis, sequence and out-of-pocket applicability travel in `bps-cost-share`.

medicare_advantage.note: The key is an `identifier` with system `https://benefitplanstandard.org/fhir/identifier/cms_contract_plan_segment`, for example H1609-028-000. The document's `plan_id` is the first `identifier`.

marketplace.note: The key is an `identifier` with system `https://benefitplanstandard.org/fhir/identifier/hios_plan_id`, for example 68398FL0030058-01, and the 14-character id is an `identifier` with the HIOS system `https://www.cms.gov/CCIIO/Resources/Data-Resources/hios`, for example 68398FL0030058. The document's `plan_id` is the first `identifier`. Gap G7 was closed on October 20, 2026.

medicare_advantage.note: With `plan_year` alone, `period` has year precision, for example start and end 2027, and claims no day the document does not give. The year also travels in `bps-plan-metadata`.

marketplace.note: `period` holds the coverage dates instead (see Coverage dates), so the plan year travels only in `bps-plan-metadata`.

medicare_advantage.note: The release label, for example PBP Benefits-2027, and the download date are text in the first `bps-source-reference` excerpt. The Benefit Plan Standard converter writes no timestamps.

marketplace.note: The 3 file names with their download dates, and each file's `ImportDate` as the file writes it, are text in the first `bps-source-reference` excerpt. The Benefit Plan Standard converter writes no timestamps. Gap G6 was closed on October 20, 2026.
`effective_date` and `expiry_date` fill `period.start` and `period.end`. `period.end` is left out when the document has no `expiry_date`, as in the UHC Bronze Essential Bundle.

medicare_advantage.note: The premium is a `generalCost` entry whose `type` is text only, Premium, with `cost` the amount. The file states no period, so the entry has no `comment`. Gap G3 was closed on October 20, 2026.

The reduction is a `generalCost` entry whose `type` is text only, Part B premium reduction, with `cost` the amount. A plan that answers No has no entry, and its answer is text in `bps-source-reference`. Gap G3 was closed on October 20, 2026.

items.note: Each slot is a `generalCost` entry with `type` coded deductible and `cost` the amount. `generalCost` has no network element, so the network travels in `type.text`, `comment` and `bps-accumulator`.

medicare_advantage.note: When the plan uses the Medicare-defined deductible, no slot is written and the answer travels as text in `bps-source-reference`.

marketplace.note: The family amount's `embedded` flag travels in `comment` and `bps-accumulator`.

items.note: Each slot is a `generalCost` entry with `type` coded maxoutofpocket and `cost` the amount. `generalCost` has no network element, so the network travels in `type.text`, `comment` and `bps-accumulator`.

medicare_advantage.note: The document has `contacts`, but the Benefit Plan Standard converter does not map it yet: the SBC InsurancePlan profile requires `contact`, which the converter writes with data-absent-reason unknown and no telecom. marketplace.note: The CARIN excluded-services extension is not filled from this text; converter specification section 10.1 derives it from the plan's coverage flags.

items.note: Each out-of-network cost entry has `applicability` out-of-network. A placed benefit with no out-of-network row gets a placeholder out-of-network entry whose value is data-absent-reason unknown; it never says not covered.

medicare_advantage.note: PPO plans have the OUT tier and HMO-POS plans the POS tier, and both are written out-of-network; the POS entries also carry a text-only qualifier (see Point-of-service cost). HMO plans have neither, so every placed benefit gets the placeholder.

marketplace.note: Every document has an OUT tier.

items.note: Each step is a `cost` entry with `applicability` out-of-network, `type` coded copay or copaypct and `value` the amount or rate. Only placed benefits have `cost` entries.

medicare_advantage.note: When the PBP gives a range, `cost.value` carries data-absent-reason unsupported and the bounds travel in `bps-cost-share`.

Each step is a `cost` entry with `applicability` out-of-network and the text-only qualifier Point-of-service option. The Cost Tier value set has no point-of-service code, so the point-of-service tier is told apart from out of network only by text; its `tierId` POS travels in `bps-cost-share`.

The address and the network's name travel as text in `bps-source-reference`. Gap G5 was closed on October 20, 2026; the mapping is a follow-up for the Benefit Plan Standard converter spec.

Tier 2 entries are in-network, like tier 1, and carry a qualifier: value-choice when the tier name says Value Choice, otherwise text only with the tier name. The Cost Tier value set has no code for tier 2, so the tier order is not coded; tier 1 entries carry no qualifier, and the `tierId` IN2 travels in `bps-cost-share`.
The plan's descriptions of that coverage are quoted beside the Yes or No answers when they are filled. Gap G8 was closed on October 20, 2026.

`AMBULANCE_AIR` (category 10a2) has the same key and is placed as its own benefit under the same category.
